Bouncers stood at the door, the clubbers danced and drank on the clubs floor whilst the celebs and rich watched from the VIP zone, even the bathrooms sounded with moans and sniffing of substances. The air was filled with music, laughter and the stench of booze as people touched and grinded against one another, everyone was horny and ready to go.. are you?*
